description: Tip a member in your room some of your ARTI, or with on a link or comment of theirs wherever they are: the tip fee goes to the house and the rest reaches them, and only the two of you are shown it. What you send in a UTC day is held to your daily transfer limit. For members.

amount.description: How much to send, in whole ARTI, from your balance. The tip fee comes out of it and the rest reaches them. What you send in a UTC day is held to your daily transfer limit.

idempotency_key.description: A name of your own for this one action: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. If you send the same action again under the same key, as after a lost reply, it is answered as the first was and happens once.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

on.description: To tip for a shared link or a comment: its id, and `to` its sharer or writer, who then need not be in your room.

to.description: The member to tip, as the room names them: player:<handle>. They must be in your room.

name: tip
